approaches.name: A: Full registry wiring with five queries and inheritance handler (recommended)
approaches.description: Add languages/php.rs modeled on java.rs and swift.rs: ELEMENT_QUERY over function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY over function_call_expression, member_call_expression, nullsafe_member_call_expression, scoped_call_expression; REFERENCE_QUERY on named_type; IMPORT_QUERY on namespace_use_declaration; DEFUSE_QUERY on assignment, augmented assignment, update, static variable and simple parameter writes plus variable_name reads; extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause children by kind. Wire tree-sitter-php in Cargo.toml (workspace and core), lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP and supported_languages, mod.rs mod line, get_language_info arm with LANGUAGE_PHP, get_ts_language arm, table test entry. Add integration test file and README update.
pros: Matches the issue acceptance criteria one-to-one
Inheritance walk is grammar-correct because it uses kinds rather than non-existent fields
Method, class and enum coverage is complete per node-types.json
cons: Requires a new Cargo.lock entry that must pass the 7-day age gate
DEFUSE_QUERY heuristics are approximate because PHP has no local declaration statement
Several files touched; full clippy and fmt pass needed

approaches.name: B: Minimal element and call support with no DEFUSE_QUERY and no inheritance
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY and IMPORT_QUERY only, set defuse_query and extract_inheritance to None in mod.rs, and wire the same Cargo, lang.rs and README entries.
pros: Smallest diff and fastest path through the age gate and CI
Element and call output is most of the user-visible value
cons: Violates the issue acceptance criteria (extract_inheritance and five constants required)
No extends/implements output for PHP classes, which the issue lists as a goal
Leaves defuse coverage untested, so extract_def_use for php returns nothing

approaches.name: C: Use tags.scm from tree-sitter-php as the element query source
approaches.description: Reuse the grammar's queries/tags.scm (TAGS_QUERY constant re-exported by the crate) as ELEMENT_QUERY, adding @function and @class captures to match parser_elements.rs expectations, and derive reference and call queries from its @reference.call and @reference.class patterns.
pros: Covers object_creation_expression reference.class and property definitions
cons: tags.scm uses @definition.* and @reference.* capture names that parser_elements.rs does not recognize, so captures must be renamed
Brings in property and interface reference patterns the issue excludes
Couples aptu queries to upstream tag naming that can change between grammar releases

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets every acceptance criterion in issue #1864, and the node kinds and fields it uses are confirmed against php/src/node-types.json and php/grammar.js (via common/define-grammar.js). The key deviation from the Java template is that the inheritance walk must find base_clause and class_interface_clause by child kind, because class_declaration has no superclass or interfaces field. Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) so HTML-embedded files parse without ERROR nodes. Verify the tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 age gate and tree-sitter-language 0.1.9 compatibility before editing Cargo.lock.

inheritance_walk_citation: Source inspected: php/grammar.js delegates to common/define-grammar.js (fetched via gh api, lines 319-390 and 1118-1125); php/src/node-types.json (v0.25.2). Rules read verbatim: class_declaration: seq(optional(field('attributes', $.attribute_list)), repeat($._modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list)); base_clause: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)); class_interface_clause: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)); _name is choice(alias(keyword('static')...), alias(CAST_TYPE_CLASS_NAMES...), reserved('classes', $.name), $.qualified_name, $.relative_name). Field walk for `class Foo extends Bar implements A, B {}`: (1) start at class_declaration node; (2) read field 'name' -> node kind name, text Foo (not an inheritance target); (3) iterate named children by kind, not by field, because base_clause and class_interface_clause have no field name; (4) child with kind 'base_clause' -> iterate its named children of kind name, qualified_name or relative_name -> emit "extends " + text (here Bar); (5) child with kind 'class_interface_clause' -> iterate its named children of kind name, qualified_name or relative_name -> emit "implements " + text for each (here A, B); (6) stop at field 'body' (declaration_list). Interface extends uses base_clause on interface_declaration (emit extends). Enum implements uses class_interface_clause on enum_declaration. Expected output for the issue example: ["extends Bar", "implements A", "implements B"]; no clauses gives []. Java's child_by_field_name("superclass") and ("interfaces") return None here.
